speak: Business Number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year end. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Line 103. Amount upper case A. Total eligible expenditures for research and development in the current tax year.
Line 120. Amount upper case B. Current year credit earned (Amount upper case A multiplied by 15%).
Line 130. Amount lower case a. Credit allocated to the corporation that is a member of a partnership.
Line 140. Amount lower case b. Credit allocated to the corporation that is a beneficiary under a trust.
Subtotal. Line 130, amount lower case a plus Line 140, amount lower case b.
Amount upper case C. Amount from Subtotal.
Line 160. Amount upper case D. Total current year refundable credit (Amount upper case B plus amount upper case C).
